question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**of**" indicates the point in time from which an event starts. In this context, it indicates the starting point of the eighteenth century.
 
• The phrase **"from the beginning of the eighteenth century" **correctly sets the time frame for the narrative.
 
• Other options such as "in", "on", and "about" do not fit the context or meaning appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "*From the beginning of__ the eighteenth century, the ladies of European cities covered................"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "in" – Incorrect as it does not correctly indicate the starting point of the eighteenth century.
 
• **Option 2:** "on" – Incorrect as it does not appropriately set a timeframe in this context.
 
• **Option 4:** "about" – Incorrect as it does not specify the starting point as clearly as "of".
